skills.es: Verifica el cumplimiento de datos con estándares: ISO 19650, IFC, COBie y UniFormat.

skills.name: data-anomaly-detector
skills.en: Detect anomalies and outliers in construction data: unusual costs, schedule variances, productivity spikes. Statistical and ML-based detection methods.
skills.es: Detecta anomalías y valores atípicos: costos inusuales, variaciones de cronograma y picos de productividad.

skills.name: data-lineage-tracker
skills.en: Track data origin, transformations, and flow through construction systems. Essential for audit trails, compliance, and debugging data issues.
skills.es: Rastrea el origen, las transformaciones y el flujo de datos; clave para auditoría y depuración.

skills.name: data-quality-check
skills.en: Assess construction data quality using completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and validity metrics. Automated validation with regex patterns, thresholds, and reporting.
skills.es: Evalúa la calidad de datos: completitud, exactitud, consistencia, oportunidad y validez, con validación automática.

skills.name: validation-rules-builder
skills.en: Build validation rules for construction data. Create RegEx and logic-based validation for BIM elements, cost codes, and schedule data.
skills.es: Construye reglas de validación con RegEx y lógica para elementos BIM, códigos de costo y cronogramas.

skills.name: cost-estimation-resource
skills.en: Calculate construction costs using resource-based method. Estimate project costs from work items, physical resource norms, and current prices.
skills.es: Calcula costos con el método por recursos: ítems de trabajo, normas físicas de recursos y precios vigentes.

skills.name: estimate-builder
skills.en: Build construction project estimates. Generate detailed cost breakdowns with labor, materials, equipment, and overhead.
skills.es: Construye estimaciones de proyecto con desglose de mano de obra, materiales, equipo e indirectos.

skills.name: historical-cost-analyzer
skills.en: Analyze historical construction costs for benchmarking, trend analysis, and estimating calibration. Compare projects, track escalation, identify patterns.
skills.es: Analiza costos históricos para comparación, tendencias y calibración de estimaciones.

skills.name: labor-rate
skills.en: Calculate construction labor rates with overhead, benefits, and productivity factors. Regional rate databases and crew composition.
skills.es: Calcula tarifas de mano de obra con cargas, prestaciones y factores de productividad.

skills.name: unit-price-database-manager
skills.en: Manage construction unit price databases: update prices, track vendors, apply location factors, maintain historical records. Essential for accurate estimating.
skills.es: Administra bases de precios unitarios: actualiza precios, proveedores, factores de ubicación e histórico.

skills.name: auto-estimate-generator
skills.en: Automatically generate estimates from QTO data. Apply pricing rules to BIM quantities for cost estimates.
skills.es: Genera estimaciones automáticas desde datos de cómputos aplicando reglas de precio a cantidades BIM.

skills.name: bim-qto
skills.en: Extract quantities from BIM/CAD data for cost estimation. Group by type, level, zone. Generate QTO reports.
skills.es: Extrae cantidades de datos BIM/CAD para estimar costos, agrupadas por tipo, nivel y zona.

skills.name: qto-report
skills.en: Generate Quantity Take-Off (QTO) reports from BIM/CAD data. Extract volumes, areas, counts by category. Group elements, apply calculation rules, and create cost estimates automatically.
skills.es: Genera informes de cómputos métricos desde BIM/CAD: volúmenes, áreas y conteos por categoría.

skills.name: 4d-simulation
skills.en: Create 4D construction simulations by linking BIM elements to project schedules. Generate time-based visualizations, sequence analysis, and construction phasing with Gantt integration.
skills.es: Crea simulaciones 4D vinculando elementos BIM con el cronograma, con visualización en el tiempo y análisis de secuencia.

skills.name: co2-estimation
skills.en: Calculate carbon footprint of construction projects. Estimate CO2 emissions from materials, transportation, and construction processes using emission factors databases.
skills.es: Calcula la huella de carbono del proyecto: emisiones de materiales, transporte y procesos constructivos.

skills.name: gantt-chart
skills.en: Generate Gantt charts for construction scheduling. Create visual project timelines with dependencies and progress tracking.
skills.es: Genera diagramas de Gantt para programar obra, con dependencias y seguimiento de avance.

skills.name: lifecycle-carbon-calculator
skills.en: Calculate embodied carbon and lifecycle emissions for construction materials and projects. Support sustainable design decisions with carbon data.
skills.es: Calcula carbono incorporado y emisiones del ciclo de vida de materiales y proyectos.

skills.name: resource-leveler
skills.en: Level and optimize construction resource allocation across project schedule. Balance labor, equipment usage, and avoid overallocation while maintaining critical path.
skills.es: Nivela y optimiza la asignación de recursos en el cronograma y evita sobreasignación.

skills.name: erp-data-extractor
skills.en: Extract and analyze data from construction ERP systems. Pull project data for analytics, reporting, and integration.
skills.es: Extrae y analiza datos de sistemas ERP de construcción para analítica e integración.

skills.name: interoperability-analyzer
skills.en: Analyze data interoperability issues in construction projects. Identify format incompatibilities and data loss points.
skills.es: Analiza problemas de interoperabilidad: incompatibilidades de formato y puntos de pérdida de datos.

skills.name: data-visualization
skills.en: Create visualizations for construction data. Generate charts, graphs, heatmaps, and interactive dashboards using Matplotlib, Seaborn, and Plotly for project analysis and reporting.
skills.es: Crea visualizaciones de datos de construcción con Matplotlib, Seaborn y Plotly: gráficos, mapas de calor y tableros.

skills.name: decision-support
skills.en: Provide data-driven decision support for construction. Analyze multiple factors and recommend optimal project decisions.
skills.es: Apoyo a decisiones con datos: analiza varios factores y recomienda la mejor opción para el proyecto.

skills.name: kpi-dashboard
skills.en: Build KPI dashboards for construction projects. Track CPI, SPI, quality, safety metrics in real-time.
skills.es: Construye tableros de indicadores (CPI, SPI, calidad, seguridad) en tiempo real.

skills.name: predictive-analytics-construction
skills.en: Forecast project outcomes using historical data: cost overruns, schedule delays, risk probabilities. Machine learning models for construction prediction.
skills.es: Pronostica resultados con datos históricos: sobrecostos, retrasos y probabilidades de riesgo con aprendizaje automático.

skills.name: scenario-planner
skills.en: What-if analysis for construction projects: model different scenarios and their cost/schedule/resource impacts. Compare alternatives and optimize decisions.
skills.es: Análisis de escenarios: modela el impacto en costo, cronograma y recursos y compara alternativas.

skills.name: airflow-dag
skills.en: Create Apache Airflow DAGs for construction data pipelines. Orchestrate ETL, validation, and reporting workflows.
skills.es: Crea DAG de Apache Airflow para flujos de datos de construcción: ETL, validación e informes.

skills.name: etl-pipeline
skills.en: Build automated ETL (Extract-Transform-Load) pipelines for construction data. Process PDFs, Excel, BIM exports. Generate reports, dashboards, and integrate with other systems. Orchestrate with Airflow or n8n.
skills.es: Construye flujos ETL automáticos para datos de construcción: PDF, Excel y exportaciones BIM.

skills.name: pdf-report-generator
skills.en: Automatically generate PDF reports from construction data. Create formatted project reports with charts and tables.
skills.es: Genera informes PDF de datos de construcción con gráficos y tablas.

skills.name: workflow-automation
skills.en: Automate construction data workflows. Build ETL pipelines and DAG workflows for recurring tasks.
skills.es: Automatiza flujos de datos recurrentes mediante ETL y DAG.

skills.name: bim-consistency-checker
skills.en: Check BIM model consistency: naming conventions, parameter completeness, spatial relationships, and data integrity across model elements.
skills.es: Verifica la consistencia del modelo BIM: nomenclatura, parámetros completos, relaciones espaciales e integridad.

skills.name: bim-validation-pipeline
skills.en: Build automated BIM validation pipelines for IFC/Revit data. Continuous validation against IDS, LOD requirements, COBie, and project-specific BEP standards.
skills.es: Construye flujos automáticos de validación BIM para IFC/Revit contra IDS, LOD, COBie y requisitos del proyecto.

skills.name: clash-resolution-analyzer
skills.en: Analyze BIM clash detection results and suggest resolutions. Prioritize clashes, identify patterns, assign responsibility, and track resolution status.
skills.es: Analiza resultados de detección de interferencias y sugiere soluciones: prioriza, halla patrones y asigna responsables.

skills.name: ids-checker
skills.en: Check BIM data against IDS (Information Delivery Specification). Validate model information requirements and compliance.
skills.es: Verifica datos BIM contra IDS (Especificación de Entrega de Información) y los requisitos del modelo.

skills.name: big-data-analysis
skills.en: Analyze large-scale construction datasets. Process thousands of projects for patterns, benchmarks, and predictive insights.
skills.es: Analiza grandes conjuntos de datos de construcción: miles de proyectos para patrones y referentes.

skills.name: parquet-converter
skills.en: Convert construction data to/from Parquet format. Optimize storage, enable fast queries, and integrate with data lakehouses.
skills.es: Convierte datos de construcción desde y hacia Parquet para consultas rápidas y almacenamiento optimizado.

skills.name: vector-search
skills.en: Implement semantic vector search for construction data. Build AI-powered search using embeddings and vector databases (Qdrant, ChromaDB) for intelligent querying of specifications, standards, and project documents.
skills.es: Implementa búsqueda semántica vectorial (Qdrant, ChromaDB) para datos de construcción.

skills.name: cost-prediction
skills.en: Predict construction project costs using Machine Learning. Use Linear Regression, K-Nearest Neighbors, and Random Forest models on historical project data. Train, evaluate, and deploy cost prediction models.
skills.es: Predice costos con aprendizaje automático (regresión lineal, k-vecinos, bosque aleatorio) sobre datos históricos.

skills.name: duration-prediction
skills.en: Predict project duration using k-NN and regression. Estimate timeline based on similar historical projects.
skills.es: Predice la duración del proyecto con k-NN y regresión según proyectos históricos similares.

skills.name: ml-model-builder
skills.en: Build ML models for construction predictions. Train and evaluate custom models for cost, duration, and risk prediction.
skills.es: Construye modelos de aprendizaje automático para predecir costo, duración y riesgo.

skills.name: ml-model-retrainer
skills.en: Automated pipeline for retraining ML models with new construction data. Monitor model drift, trigger retraining, and validate model performance.
skills.es: Flujo automático para reentrenar modelos con datos nuevos, vigilar la deriva y validar el desempeño.

skills.name: schedule-forecaster
skills.en: Predict project completion dates using ML models. Forecast schedule delays based on current progress, historical patterns, and risk factors.
skills.es: Predice fechas de terminación con modelos de aprendizaje automático según avance, histórico y riesgos.

skills.name: digital-maturity-assessment
skills.en: Assess organization's digital transformation readiness. Evaluate data culture, technology adoption, and process maturity.
skills.es: Evalúa la preparación de la organización para la transformación digital: cultura de datos, tecnología y procesos.

skills.name: llm-document-extraction
skills.en: Extract structured data from construction documents using LLMs. Process RFIs, submittals, contracts, specifications. Convert unstructured PDFs to structured JSON/Excel.
skills.es: Extrae datos estructurados de documentos de construcción con LLM: RFI, submittals, contratos y especificaciones.

skills.name: multi-agent-estimation
skills.en: Build multi-agent AI systems for construction estimation. Use CrewAI/LangGraph to orchestrate specialized agents: QTO agent, pricing agent, validation agent. Automate complex estimation workflows.
skills.es: Sistemas multiagente de IA para estimación (CrewAI/LangGraph): agentes de cómputos, precios y otros.

skills.name: n8n-cost-estimation
skills.en: Build n8n pipeline for automated cost estimation from Revit/IFC using DDC CWICR database and LLM classification.
skills.es: Flujo n8n de estimación automática de costos desde Revit/IFC con la base CWICR y clasificación por LLM.

skills.name: n8n-daily-report
skills.en: Automate daily construction report generation using n8n workflow automation.
skills.es: Automatiza el informe diario de obra con n8n.

skills.name: n8n-photo-report
skills.en: Automate construction photo report generation using n8n with AI-powered image analysis.
skills.es: Automatiza el informe fotográfico de obra con n8n y análisis de imágenes por IA.

skills.name: n8n-project-management
skills.en: Build a complete project management system with Telegram bot, task distribution, and photo reports using n8n. Based on DDC Project Management repository.
skills.es: Sistema de gestión de proyectos con bot de Telegram, reparto de tareas e informes fotográficos usando n8n.

skills.name: n8n-pto-pipeline
skills.en: Create n8n workflow for daily task assignment from PTO engineer to foreman via Telegram bot with status reporting.
skills.es: Flujo n8n para asignar tareas diarias del ingeniero de planta al capataz por Telegram, con reporte de estado.

skills.name: telegram-field-bot
skills.en: Build Telegram bots for construction field workers. Real-time reporting, photo uploads, task assignments, progress tracking. Integrate with n8n for automated workflows.
skills.es: Crea bots de Telegram para personal de campo: reportes, fotos, asignación de tareas y seguimiento de avance.

skills.name: voice-to-report
skills.en: Convert voice recordings to structured construction reports. Field workers speak, AI transcribes and formats. Supports daily reports, safety observations, progress updates.
skills.es: Convierte grabaciones de voz en informes de obra estructurados: el personal habla y la IA transcribe y da formato.

skills.name: uberization-readiness
skills.en: Assess company readiness for construction industry uberization. Analyze data transparency, process automation, and competitive positioning against open data platforms.
skills.es: Evalúa la preparación de una empresa para la «uberización» del sector: transparencia de datos y automatización.

skills.name: compliance-tracker
skills.en: Track regulatory compliance for construction projects. Monitor permits, certifications, inspections, and regulatory requirements with automated alerts and reporting.
skills.es: Sigue el cumplimiento normativo del proyecto: permisos, certificaciones e inspecciones.

skills.name: incident-reporting
skills.en: Construction safety incident reporting and analysis. Capture incidents, conduct investigations, track corrective actions, and analyze trends for prevention.
skills.es: Reporte y análisis de incidentes de seguridad: captura, investigación, acciones correctivas y tendencias.

skills.name: quality-control-workflow
skills.en: Construction quality control workflow automation. Manage QC inspections, track defects, generate NCRs, and ensure specification compliance throughout the project.
skills.es: Automatiza el control de calidad: inspecciones, defectos, no conformidades y cumplimiento de especificaciones.

skills.name: safety-inspection-checklist
skills.en: Digital safety inspection checklists for construction sites. Generate, conduct, and track safety inspections with automated reporting and compliance monitoring.
skills.es: Listas digitales de inspección de seguridad: generar, realizar y seguir inspecciones con informes automáticos.

skills.name: toolbox-talk-generator
skills.en: Generate safety toolbox talks for construction crews. Create contextual safety briefings based on weather, work activities, and recent incidents. Support multiple languages.
skills.es: Genera charlas de seguridad para cuadrillas según clima, actividades e incidentes recientes.

skills.name: critical-path-analyzer
skills.en: Analyze construction schedule critical path. Identify critical activities, calculate float, simulate schedule impacts, and optimize project duration.
skills.es: Analiza la ruta crítica: actividades críticas, holguras y riesgo de cronograma.

skills.name: delay-analysis
skills.en: Analyze construction schedule delays for claims and recovery. Perform time impact analysis, identify delay causes, calculate damages, and document for disputes.
skills.es: Analiza retrasos del cronograma para reclamaciones y recuperación: análisis de impacto en el tiempo y daños.

skills.name: look-ahead-scheduler
skills.en: Generate rolling look-ahead schedules for construction. Create 2-week, 3-week, or 6-week look-aheads with constraint analysis and crew coordination.
skills.es: Genera programaciones móviles de 2, 3 o 6 semanas con análisis de restricciones y coordinación de cuadrillas.

skills.name: resource-allocation-optimizer
skills.en: Optimize construction resource allocation across activities. Level resources, resolve over-allocations, and balance workload while minimizing schedule impact.
skills.es: Optimiza la asignación de recursos entre actividades: nivela, resuelve sobreasignaciones y balancea carga.

skills.name: schedule-compression
skills.en: Compress construction schedules using crashing and fast-tracking techniques. Analyze cost-time tradeoffs and find optimal acceleration strategies.
skills.es: Comprime cronogramas con aceleración y ejecución en paralelo; analiza el equilibrio costo-tiempo.

skills.name: change-order-manager
skills.en: Manage construction change orders from request to approval. Track costs, schedule impacts, and maintain audit trail for dispute prevention.
skills.es: Gestiona órdenes de cambio desde la solicitud hasta la aprobación, con trazabilidad para evitar disputas.

skills.name: claims-documentation
skills.en: Document construction claims for disputes and recovery. Compile evidence, calculate damages, track notice requirements, and prepare claim packages.
skills.es: Documenta reclamaciones de obra: evidencias, cálculo de daños y requisitos de notificación.

skills.name: contract-clause-extractor
skills.en: Extract and analyze key clauses from construction contracts. Identify payment terms, change order procedures, dispute resolution, warranties, and risk allocation provisions.
skills.es: Extrae y analiza cláusulas clave de contratos: pagos, órdenes de cambio, disputas y garantías.

skills.name: lien-waiver-tracker
skills.en: Track and manage construction lien waivers. Monitor conditional and unconditional waivers, ensure compliance before payments, and prevent lien exposure.
skills.es: Sigue renuncias de gravamen condicionales e incondicionales y verifica el cumplimiento antes de pagar.

skills.name: input-validation
skills.en: Validate construction data inputs before processing: cost estimates, schedules, BIM data, field reports. Catch errors early with domain-specific rules.
skills.es: Valida entradas antes de procesarlas: estimaciones, cronogramas, datos BIM e informes de campo.

skills.name: schema-validation
skills.en: JSON/data schema validation for construction data exchange: API payloads, file imports, BIM exports. Ensure data structure compliance before processing.
skills.es: Valida esquemas JSON/datos en intercambios: cargas de API, importaciones y exportaciones BIM.

skills.name: docx-construction

skills.name: email-construction

skills.es: Genera correos para flujos de obra: respuestas a RFI, envíos de submittals, avisos de reunión y órdenes de cambio.

skills.name: pdf-construction
skills.en: PDF processing for construction documents: RFIs, submittals, specifications, drawing packages. Extract data, merge packages, fill forms.
skills.es: Procesa PDF de construcción (RFI, submittals, especificaciones, planos): extrae datos, une paquetes y llena formularios.

skills.name: pptx-construction
skills.en: PowerPoint generation for construction: project updates, stakeholder presentations, progress reports, bid presentations. Automated slide creation with charts and data.
skills.es: Genera presentaciones PowerPoint de construcción: avances, interesados, informes y licitaciones.

skills.name: xlsx-construction
skills.en: Excel/spreadsheet processing for construction: estimates, schedules, tracking logs, quantity takeoffs. Formulas, formatting, analysis.
skills.es: Procesa hojas de cálculo de construcción: estimaciones, cronogramas, registros, cómputos, fórmulas y análisis.

skills.name: budget-variance-analyzer
skills.en: Analyze construction budget variances. Compare estimated vs actual costs, identify trends, forecast final costs, and generate variance reports for cost control.
skills.es: Analiza variaciones de presupuesto vs. costo real: sobrecostos, pronóstico del costo final e informes.

skills.name: cashflow-forecaster
skills.en: Forecast construction project cash flow. Project income and expenses, identify funding gaps, and optimize payment timing for improved financial management.
skills.es: Pronostica el flujo de caja del proyecto: ingresos y gastos, brechas de financiación y momento de pagos.

skills.name: payment-application-processor
skills.en: Process construction payment applications. Validate schedule of values, calculate retainage, track billing status, and generate G702/G703 forms.
skills.es: Procesa solicitudes de pago: valida el cuadro de valores, calcula retenciones y genera formatos G702/G703.

skills.name: retention-tracker
skills.en: Track construction retainage/retention amounts. Monitor held amounts by subcontractor, track release conditions, and manage retainage billing.
skills.es: Sigue los montos de retención por subcontratista, condiciones de liberación y facturación.

skills.name: few-shot-examples
skills.en: Curated few-shot examples for construction AI tasks: classification, extraction, analysis. Domain-specific examples for improved LLM performance.
skills.es: Ejemplos de pocos disparos para tareas de IA de construcción: clasificación, extracción y análisis.

skills.name: prompt-templates
skills.en: Reusable prompt templates for construction AI tasks: cost estimation, schedule analysis, document processing, BIM queries. Structured prompts for consistent results.
skills.es: Plantillas de prompts reutilizables para IA de construcción: costos, cronogramas, documentos y consultas BIM.

skills.name: continuous-learning-construction
skills.en: Automatically extract patterns, best practices, and reusable knowledge from construction automation sessions to improve future performance.
skills.es: Extrae patrones y buenas prácticas de sesiones de automatización de construcción para mejorar a futuro.

skills.name: security-review-construction
skills.en: Security review checklist for construction software systems. Use when building integrations, APIs, data pipelines, or dashboards for construction projects.
skills.es: Lista de revisión de seguridad para software de construcción: integraciones, APIs, flujos de datos y tableros.

skills.name: verification-loop-construction
skills.en: Comprehensive verification system for construction automation deliverables. Use after completing estimates, schedules, reports, or data processing tasks to ensure quality.
skills.es: Sistema de verificación de entregables de automatización de construcción: estimaciones, cronogramas e informes.

skills.name: ai-act-compliance
skills.en: Check construction AI systems against the EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689): classify risk of estimation, scheduling, CV and agent tools, document transparency, keep human oversight. Use when deploying or auditing AI in construction.
skills.es: Revisa sistemas de IA de construcción frente al Reglamento de IA de la UE (2024/1689) y clasifica su riesgo.

skills.name: ai-agent-orchestration
skills.en: Orchestrate multiple AI agents for construction workflows: estimator, scheduler, document, QA and safety agents coordinated by a supervisor agent, with human checkpoints. Use when automating end-to-end project processes with agentic AI.
skills.es: Orquesta varios agentes de IA para flujos de obra: estimador, programador, documentos, calidad y seguridad.

skills.name: as-built-documentation
skills.en: Automate as-built documentation and digital handover for construction. Compile project records, generate O&M manuals, create asset databases, and ensure complete project closeout.
skills.es: Gestiona la documentación as-built para el cierre: marcas en planos, actualizaciones y verificación de completitud.

skills.name: bim-visual-programming-automation
skills.en: Automate BIM workflows using visual programming and Python. Create parametric schedules, export data, batch modify elements, and integrate with external data sources.
skills.es: Automatiza flujos BIM con programación visual y Python: tablas paramétricas, exportación y modificación por lote.

skills.name: capacity-planning
skills.en: Plan organizational capacity for construction projects. Forecast resource needs, identify capacity gaps, and support strategic planning for project pursuit and staffing.
skills.es: Planifica la capacidad organizacional: necesidades de recursos, brechas y apoyo a la planeación estratégica.

skills.name: change-order-analysis
skills.en: Analyze and predict construction change orders using ML. Classify change order types, predict costs and schedule impacts, identify patterns, and optimize approval workflows.
skills.es: Analiza y predice órdenes de cambio con aprendizaje automático: tipos, costos e impactos en cronograma.

skills.name: clash-detection-analysis
skills.en: Detect and analyze geometric clashes between BIM elements. Identify hard clashes, soft clashes, and workflow conflicts using spatial analysis and rule-based detection.
skills.es: Detecta y analiza interferencias geométricas entre elementos BIM: duras, blandas y de flujo de trabajo.

skills.name: contractor-matching-ai
skills.en: AI-powered contractor matching and selection for construction projects. Analyze contractor capabilities, past performance, certifications, and project requirements to recommend optimal matches.
skills.es: Selección de contratistas con IA: capacidades, desempeño pasado y certificaciones.

skills.name: defect-detection-ai

skills.es: Detección de defectos con visión por computador: grietas, desprendimientos y corrosión en concreto y acero.

skills.name: digital-twin-sync

skills.es: Sincroniza gemelos digitales con datos en tiempo real: modelos BIM, sensores IoT y avance de campo.

skills.name: document-classification-nlp
skills.en: Automatically classify and extract information from construction documents using NLP. Categorize RFIs, submittals, change orders, specifications, and contracts.
skills.es: Clasifica documentos de construcción y extrae información con PLN: RFI, submittals, órdenes de cambio y especificaciones.

skills.name: drone-site-survey

skills.es: Procesa levantamientos con dron: ortomosaicos, modelos de elevación, nubes de puntos, volúmenes y avance.

skills.name: embodied-carbon-esg

skills.name: energy-simulation

skills.es: Simulación energética de edificios: cargas de calefacción y refrigeración, envolvente y dimensionamiento HVAC.

skills.en: USE FOR: triaging a backlog of open GitHub issues — judging which are actionable, labelling and typing them, linking duplicates and parents, and closing what is dead. NOT FOR: writing one new issue, scheduling committed work, or reviewing pull requests.

skills.name: discussion-participation
skills.en: USE FOR: taking part in GitHub Discussions — finding the unanswered questions in a category, reading a thread in full, replying to it, and marking the reply that resolved it. NOT FOR: commenting on an issue or a proposed change, or working through a backlog.

skills.name: codebase-exploration
skills.en: USE FOR: understanding an unfamiliar repository and how it got that way — its layout, where a behaviour is implemented, and when and why a particular function or line last changed. NOT FOR: editing files, or assessing whether a project is healthy overall.

skills.name: copilot-task-delegation
skills.en: USE FOR: handing a piece of work to the Copilot coding agent — judging whether an issue is scoped tightly enough to delegate, launching it, and asking for an automated first-pass review of a proposed change. NOT FOR: doing the work directly, or reviewing what comes back.

skills.name: account-and-team-context
skills.en: USE FOR: establishing who the authenticated account is, which organisations and teams it belongs to, who sits on a team, and who has write access to a repository. NOT FOR: finding an unfamiliar repository, or choosing what work to do next.

skills.name: issue-authoring
skills.en: USE FOR: filing one clear bug report or feature request — checking it is not already reported, choosing its type and fields, breaking it into sub-issues, and giving it a title and body someone can act on. NOT FOR: working through an existing backlog, or discussing an open question with a community.

skills.name: label-scheme-management
skills.en: USE FOR: curating the label vocabulary a repository uses — adding ones it lacks, auditing which are actually applied, renaming and recolouring them, merging overlapping ones, and tidying away the unused. NOT FOR: applying an existing label to an issue, or deciding which issues matter.

skills.name: notification-triage
skills.en: USE FOR: working through a GitHub notification inbox — deciding what needs a reply, what to unsubscribe from, and what to mark read or done. NOT FOR: triaging a repository issue backlog, or answering review threads on one specific pull request.

skills.name: pull-request-authoring
skills.en: USE FOR: taking a branch of work through to landed — opening the pull request, describing it, requesting reviewers, keeping it current with its base, and merging it once checks and approvals are in. NOT FOR: reviewing someone else's proposal, or acting on review comments left on yours.

skills.name: project-planning
skills.en: USE FOR: planning and updating work on a GitHub Projects board — reading fields and views, adding issues or pull requests as items, setting status and iteration, and posting a status update. NOT FOR: triaging a repository issue backlog, or preparing a release.

skills.name: claude-api
skills.en: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration. TRIGGER — read FIRST, before you answer, run a command or open a file (already started? read it now); don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens). SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file; if nothing hits, load this skill).

skills.name: code-review
skills.en: Review the current diff, or a PR number/branch/path target, for correctness bugs (plus reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups where the model's recipe covers them) at the effort level given first, before any target (low|medium|high|xhigh|max: from few high-confidence findings to many, some uncertain; ultra: deep multi-agent review in the cloud (requires claude.ai account access)); with no level given, it reuses the level you typed last. Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply them to the working tree after the review. Pass --max-findings <n> to report up to n findings, or --max-findings all for every finding. The choice stays until you pass --max-findings default. For ultra on a GitHub.com PR target, --post asks to post the finished review's findings to the PR as a single comment from the user's GitHub account (not a review; the launch dialog still confirms in interactive sessions, while non-interactive mode posts on the flag alone) and --no-post hides that option.

It is not for websites, which go through Claude in Chrome or the built-in browser and their own skills.

skills.name: dataviz

Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. When the destination is a first-party document connector (host-designated, never self-described) that renders live charts, hand it the rows (inline, or as an uploaded data file the chart cites) rather than a rendered PNG/SVG — a picture of a chart loses hover, data inspection and per-value comments. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
